final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.bats, c.cnt AS player_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share, c.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_avg FROM c, t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt
